t: This is Hughes Parry Hall, a university residence that was one of eight intercollegiate halls of the University of London. It belongs to the Garden Halls group, which shared a bursarial team with Canterbury Hall and Commonwealth Hall. The name honours Sir David Hughes Parry, a Professor of Law who served as Vice-Chancellor of the University of London from 1945 to 1948. In 1947 he founded the university's Institute of Advanced Legal Studies.
